title: 2.3 Commercial arithmetic: interest, hire purchase, appreciation and depreciation

q.Q1: Q1. Find the simple interest on KSh 40 000 at 9% per year for 3 years.
q.Q2: Q2. How long will it take KSh 25 000 to earn KSh 6000 simple interest at 8% per year?

q.Q3: Q3. KSh 50 000 is invested at 10% per year compound interest for 3 years. Find the amount and the interest.

q.Q4: Q4. A fridge has a cash price of KSh 48 000. On hire purchase the deposit is KSh 12 000 plus 12 monthly instalments of KSh 3500. Find the hire purchase price and how much more it costs.
q.Q5: Q5. Express the extra cost as a percentage of the cash price.

q.Q6: Q6. A matatu bought for KSh 3 200 000 depreciates at 15% per year. Find its value after 2 years.
q.Q7: Q7. A plot worth KSh 1 500 000 appreciates at 12% per year. Find its value after 2 years.

q.Q8: Q8. Offer A: 10% simple interest per year. Offer B: 9% compound interest per year. Which gives more on KSh 100 000 after 5 years, and by how much?

q.Exit ticket: Exit ticket. Write the compound interest formula.
